newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Clal Israel names managing director.
newsitem.headline: Clal Israel names managing director.

text.p: The board of directors of Clal Israel Ltd named Yitzak Kaul, managing director of Bezeq Israel Telecom, as managing director effective April 1, 1997, the company said on Wednesday.
They also named Yossi Rosen as managing director of Clal Industries Ltd., Clal Israel's industrial-holding subsidiary, effective January 1, 1997.

Rosen is currenlty managing director of Mashav Initiating and Development Ltd, a holding company jointly controlled by Clal and Koor Industries Ltd. A spokesman said Rosen would retain his Mashav position as well for the time being.

A source at Clal said the two appointments were likely to be accompanied by structural changes in the group, which will be voted on by the board probably at the end of December. "At the end of the year, there will be a meeting on proposals concerning the structure of the organisation," the source said.
The key change would be to split off Clal Industries from Clal Israel, leaving the latter with its insurance, property and retail and trade businesses.
Clal Industries' holdings include interests in building products, energy, textiles, paper, food and, through its Clal Electronic Industries unit, high technology.

In addition, the source said Leon Recanati would be appointed chairman of Clal Israel and Clal Industries. The Recanati family, through its IDB Development Ltd, became the single biggest shareholders in Clal last October, with 43 percent, after acquiring an six percent block of shares from Bank Hapoalim.

Kaul replaces David Wainshal, who announced his intention to step down as Clal Israel's managing director last month after five years. Kaul has been leading Bezeq, the state-owned telecommunications company, through a difficult period when the company has gradually seen its monopoly on telephone service gradually whittled away.
